items.title_zh: Alinia AI 推出 Seny，为 AI 智能体提供实时法律合规管控
items.title_en: Alinia AI Launches Seny To Provide Real-Time Legal Compliance Controls For AI Agents
items.summary_zh: Alinia AI 推出名为 Seny 的新产品，定位是为 AI 智能体（AI agents）提供实时的法律合规管控能力。该消息由 Pulse 2.0 报道，目前公开信息较为有限，尚未披露具体功能清单、定价或客户案例。随着企业把具备自主决策能力的 AI 智能体逐步投入生产环境，合规性与可审计性正成为落地的前置条件之一。
items.summary_en: Alinia AI Launches Seny To Provide Real-Time Legal Compliance Controls For AI Agents Pulse 2.0
items.why_zh: 它反映出 AI 智能体从演示走向生产后，“可监管、可审计”正成为企业采购的硬性门槛。
items.why_en: It reflects how auditable compliance is becoming a hard prerequisite as AI agents move from demos into production.

items.title_zh: 谷歌发布 Gemini 4 Argon 模型，Alphabet 股价走高
items.title_en: Alphabet Shares Rise After Google Launches Gemini 4 Argon AI Model
items.summary_zh: 据 Yahoo Finance 报道，在谷歌发布 Gemini 4 Argon AI 模型后，母公司 Alphabet 的股价出现上涨。报道将股价的积极表现与这次模型发布直接关联，显示市场把这代新模型视为谷歌在 AI 竞争中保持势头的信号。目前关于该模型的具体能力、参数规模和开放范围等细节尚未在标题信息中披露。
items.summary_en: Alphabet Shares Rise After Google Launches Gemini 4 Argon AI Model Yahoo Finance
items.why_zh: 新一轮旗舰模型发布能直接拉动 Alphabet 股价，说明市场仍以模型迭代速度衡量大厂的 AI 竞争力。
items.why_en: A single flagship model release moving Alphabet's stock shows markets still gauge Big Tech's AI standing by model cadence.

items.title_zh: 日本电力巨头 JERA 牵手戴尔等伙伴，将在千叶建设该国最大 AI 数据中心
items.title_en: Japan's JERA Teams With Dell and Partners to Build Country's Largest AI Data Center in Chiba
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 1 日消息，日本供电规模最大的电力公司 JERA（捷热）当地时间今日与 Dell（戴尔）、主权人工智能基础设施开发商 RHAELM 当地时间今日签署谅解备忘录，三方将共同制定日本人工智能基础设施建设标准化框架。 备忘录下的首个数据中心将落地东京东侧的千叶县。其设计容量达 400MW， 是日本最大的单一数据中心站点 ，总投资规模预计将超过 150 亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 1,007.53 亿元人民币） 。Apollo 将为该项目提供投融资支持。 这座 AI 数据中心位于 JERA 自有火力发电站附近，采用表后供电。其 配套电力基础设施的建设和审核时间因此大幅缩短 ，站点有望于 2028 年上线运行。 JERA 和 RHAELM 还计划将这一模式扩展到其它 JERA站点，目标到 21 世纪 30 年代实现多 GW 级别的 AI 基础设施容量。
items.summary_en: Japan's largest power utility JERA signed an MOU with Dell and sovereign AI infrastructure developer RHAELM to set a standardized framework for AI infrastructure in Japan. The first site, in Chiba east of Tokyo, is designed at 400MW — the country's largest single data center — with total investment expected to top $15 billion, backed by Apollo financing. Sited next to a JERA thermal plant and using behind-the-meter power, it could come online in 2028, with plans to scale the model to multi-GW capacity by the 2030s.
items.why_zh: 电力公司与科技企业联手、用自有电厂就近供电，为破解 AI 数据中心的电力与审批瓶颈提供了一种可复制的模式。
items.why_en: A utility-tech partnership using on-site power offers a replicable fix for the power and permitting bottlenecks facing AI data centers.

items.title_zh: 全球 AI 法律指南发布，AI 智能体带来新法律挑战
items.title_en: Global AI law guide launches as agentic AI raises new legal challenges
items.summary_zh: 一份面向全球的 AI 法律指南正式发布，其背景是“智能体式 AI”（agentic AI）的兴起正在带来新的法律难题。报道指出，能够在较少人工干预下自主执行任务的 AI 系统，对现有法律框架提出了问责、责任归属与合规方面的挑战。该指南旨在为跨法域的从业者提供参考。
items.summary_en: Global AI law guide launches as agentic AI raises new legal challenges globallegalpost.com
items.why_zh: 智能体式 AI 让责任如何归属变得模糊，跨国法律指南的出现说明监管空白正被系统性填补。
items.why_en: Agentic AI blurs liability, and a global legal guide signals regulators are starting to close that gap systematically.

items.title_zh: AI 拉动半导体需求暴涨，韩国 9 月出口创历史新高
items.title_en: AI-Driven Chip Demand Sends South Korea's September Exports to a Record High
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 1 日消息，据彭博社报道，受全球人工智能需求持续拉动半导体出口的推动，韩国 9 月出口延续迅猛增势，进一步增强外界预期：这个高度依赖贸易的经济体有能力承受更高的利率水平。 韩国海关当地时间周四发布的数据显示，剔除工作日差异影响后，9 月出口同比增幅达到 104.9%；出口总额达到 1,209 亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 8,120.71 亿元人民币） ，创下历史新高。而该月前 20 天的出口货值此前就已经刷新该时段的历史纪录。 韩国海关部门同时表示，2026 年前九个月韩国出口总额达到创纪录的 8,145 亿美元 （现汇率约合 5.47 万亿元人民币） ，首次突破 8,000 亿美元 （现汇率约合 5.37 万亿元人民币） 关口。未经调整口径下，9 月出口同比上涨 83.5%；8 月修正后的增幅为 68.7%。进口同比增长 26%，当月贸易顺差接近 500 亿美元 （现汇率约合 3,358.44 亿元人民币） 。 半导体依旧是本轮出口繁荣的核心引擎，芯片出口同比猛增 263%，达到 603 亿美元 （现汇率约合 4,050.28 亿元人民币） 。计算机产品出口飙升 435%，石油制品出口上涨 72%；汽车出口则下滑 5%。 值得一提的是，今年 9 月受 9 月 24‑26 日秋夕假期影响，实际工作日有所减少；而去年的秋夕假期落在 10 月。这种日历效应会干…
items.summary_en: South Korea's September exports hit a record high, driven by AI-fueled semiconductor demand, with chip exports surging 263% year on year. The trade surplus neared $50 billion, and cumulative exports for the first nine months topped $800 billion for the first time.
items.why_zh: AI 算力需求已成为韩国出口乃至其宏观经济的核心驱动力，显示全球半导体周期与 AI 投资高度绑定。
items.why_en: AI compute demand is now a core driver of South Korea's exports and economy, showing how tightly the global chip cycle is tied to AI investment.

items.title_zh: 软银完成对 OpenAI 最后一笔投资，300 亿美元承诺全部到位
items.title_en: SoftBank Completes Final OpenAI Investment, Full $30B Commitment Now in Place
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 1 日消息，软银集团今日表示，公司已通过软银愿景基金 2 完成对 OpenAI 的第三笔投资，金额为 100 亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 671.69 亿元人民币） ，这是软银对 OpenAI 的最后一笔投资。至此， 软银此前承诺的 300 亿美元 （现汇率约合 2,015.06 亿元人民币） 投资全部到位 。 OpenAI 的估值正处于快速上升阶段。据彭博社报道， 该人工智能实验室在寻求新一轮融资 ，至少 300 亿美元。 软银完成此次投资后，预计将持有 OpenAI 约 13% 股份。此次投资的资金源于软银债券，路透社表示， 这笔债券是全球迄今为止规模最大的企业高收益债券发行 。 对软银而言，这些资金既是机遇也是风险：一方面它为软银继续推进 AI 战略提供充足资金；另一方面也让公司更加依赖，信贷市场状况及单一资本密集型行业的发展情况。
items.summary_en: SoftBank said on Oct 1 it has completed its third and final investment in OpenAI — $10 billion through SoftBank Vision Fund 2 — bringing its full $30 billion commitment to completion. The investment is expected to give SoftBank roughly a 13% stake and was funded by bonds that Reuters called the largest corporate high-yield issuance ever. OpenAI is meanwhile reportedly seeking at least $30 billion in a new funding round.
items.why_zh: 这是 AI 领域规模最大的单笔企业投资之一，也显示 OpenAI 的扩张正高度依赖债务融资支撑。
items.why_en: It is one of the largest single-company bets in AI history and shows how heavily OpenAI's expansion now relies on debt financing.

items.title_zh: FTC 据称就 AI 安全对 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 展开调查
items.title_en: FTC reportedly launches probe into Anthropic, OpenAI over AI safety
items.summary_zh: 据 Daily Sabah 报道，美国联邦贸易委员会（FTC）据称已对 Anthropic 与 OpenAI 展开调查，焦点涉及 AI 安全。目前公开信息有限，报道未披露调查的具体范围、时间表或可能后果。两家公司也尚未就相关报道作出公开回应。
items.summary_en: FTC reportedly launches probe into Anthropic, OpenAI over AI safety Daily Sabah
items.why_zh: 监管机构对头部 AI 实验室的安全实践启动调查，可能影响行业合规要求与模型发布节奏。
items.why_en: A regulatory probe into leading AI labs could shape compliance requirements and the pace of model releases across the industry.

items.title_zh: 微软更新 1.140 版 VS Code：多文件夹会话、远程 AI Agent 任务委派等
items.title_en: Microsoft Ships VS Code 1.140: Multi-Folder Sessions, Remote AI Agent Task Delegation
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 1 日消息，微软昨日（9 月 30 日）更新推出 1.140 稳定版 Visual Studio Code，本次更新重点围绕 GitHub Copilot Agent 工作流展开， 新增多文件夹会话、远程任务委派、模型协同编排及企业级 AI 管理能力。 VS Code 1.140 引入实验性多文件夹会话功能。同一 Agent 会话中的不同聊天，可以分别绑定到不同代码仓库或 Git worktree，彼此之间的终端、任务、代码变更、Pull Request 和合并状态相互隔离，避免修改意外串联。 本次更新还增强 Copilot harness，由 Copilot SDK 提供支持，在基于智能体主机协议 (AHP) 的专用智能体主机进程中运行，统一 VS Code、Copilot 应用和 Copilot CLI 的 Agent 行为。 本次更新还以研究预览形式，推出 HydraFusion 模型编排，自动选择模型和工作流程，可让模型对结果进行批评、修订，以平衡速度、成本和代码质量。IT之家附上相关视频如下： 远程任务委派方面，新版 Agent 可发现远程主机，根据操作系统、内存、CPU 和负载选择主机，并创建远程会话执行任务。
items.summary_en: Microsoft released VS Code 1.140, centered on GitHub Copilot Agent workflows: experimental multi-folder sessions that bind separate chats to different repos or Git worktrees, remote task delegation that selects hosts by OS, memory, CPU and load, a Copilot SDK-powered harness running on the Agent Host Protocol to unify behavior across VS Code, the Copilot app and Copilot CLI, plus a research-preview HydraFusion orchestration that balances speed, cost and code quality.
items.why_zh: AI 编程助手正从单文件补全走向可编排、可远程执行的 Agent 平台，开发工作流的组织方式随之改变。
items.why_en: It marks AI coding assistants' shift from single-file completion toward orchestratable, remotely executed agent platforms, changing how development workflows are organized.

items.title_zh: 美国监管机构就 AI 安全对 Anthropic、OpenAI 展开广泛调查
items.title_en: US regulator launches broad investigation into Anthropic, OpenAI over AI safety
items.summary_zh: 据《中国日报》全球版报道，美国监管机构已针对 AI 安全问题对 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 展开广泛调查。目前公开信息有限，报道未披露发起调查的具体机构、调查范围、涉及的具体事项及时间表等细节。
items.summary_en: US regulator launches broad investigation into Anthropic, OpenAI over AI safety China Daily Global Edition
items.why_zh: 监管审查直接指向两家头部 AI 实验室，可能影响其模型发布节奏与合规成本。
items.why_en: Regulatory scrutiny of two leading AI labs could affect their model release cadence and compliance costs.

items.title_zh: 超 Ai.com 成史上最大域名交易：消息称 Shopify 豪掷 1 亿美元收购 Shop.com
items.title_en: Report: Shopify Buys Shop.com for $100M, Topping AI.com as Largest Domain Deal Ever
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 1 日消息，Market America Worldwide 公司于 9 月 28 日宣布已完成一笔域名交易，将 Shop.com 域名出售给 Shopify 公司，官方并未披露交易金额 ，不过诸多可靠信源称本次交易是有史以来最大域名交易。 本次域名的出售方为 Market America Worldwide，已拥有 SHOP.COM 域名超过 34 年。Shopify 由加拿大企业家 Tobias Lütke（托比亚斯 · 卢克）等人于 2004–2006 年间创立，总部位于加拿大渥太华，是一家在纽交所 / 纳斯达克上市的电子商务公司。 该公司提供“一站式”商务基础设施：从建站模板、商品与库存管理、支付收款、物流配送，到营销推广、数据分析、多渠道销售（网站、社交媒体、线下 POS 等），全部集成在一个后台。 交易价格方面，官方虽未公布具体交易金额，不过资深域名经纪人 @andrewrosener 等诸多可靠信源指出，本次交易金额为 1 亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 6.72 亿元人民币） 。 如果消息属实，这笔涉及 Shop.com 域名交易将会成为史上最大域名交易，超过了此前报道的 7,000 万美元 （现汇率约合 4.7 亿元人民币） 的 AI.com 交易。
items.summary_en: Market America Worldwide said on Sept 28 it has sold Shop.com — a domain it owned for more than 34 years — to e-commerce company Shopify, without disclosing terms. Multiple reliable sources, including veteran domain broker @andrewrosener, put the price at $100 million, which would top the reported $70 million AI.com sale as the largest domain transaction on record.
items.why_zh: 若金额属实，这笔交易将刷新域名成交纪录，也凸显 AI 与电商时代优质 .com 域名的品牌价值。
items.why_en: If accurate, the deal would set a new record for domain sales and highlight the brand value of premium .com names in the AI and e-commerce era.

items.title_zh: 广汽昊铂埃安 BU 宣布 9 月销量 35494 辆同比增长 21.91%，连续 7 个月逆势正增长
items.title_en: GAC Aion's Haobo-Aion BU Reports 35,494 September Sales, Up 21.91% YoY, Seventh Straight Month of Growth
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 1 日消息，今天（1 日）下午，@埃安AION 官微宣布，广汽昊铂埃安 BU 的 9 月销量为 35494 辆，连续 7 个月逆势正增长。具体来看，当月同比涨幅为 21.91%，其中 i60 车型的订单突破 2 万辆。 据IT之家了解， 2027 款埃安 i60 于 9 月 15 日上市 ，共推出 6 款车型，限时焕新价 10.68 万元起。同时，2026 款 530 宁德时代标准版限时焕新价 10.36 万元。 520 宁德版车型：指导价 11.48 万元，限时焕新价 10.68 万元 520 宁德激光版车型：指导价 12.68 万元，限时焕新价 11.88 万元 700 长续航版车型：指导价 12.98 万元，限时焕新价 12.18 万元 700 激光雷达版车型：指导价 13.98 万元，限时焕新价 13.18 万元 1738 超级增程版车型：指导价 13.28 万元，限时焕新价 12.48 万元 1738 激光雷达版车型：指导价 14.28 万元，限时焕新价 13.48 万元 当月 30 日，广汽埃安宣布该车首月订单突破 20181 台。 同月， 广汽埃安 Ray7 轿车开启“先享计划” 。该车定位是“年轻人热爱的超级纯电轿车”。该车尺寸为 4960×1900×1455mm，轴距 2920mm。 新车全球首搭华为 EMB 全电线控制动，并配有华为 iTRA…
items.summary_en: GAC's Haobo-Aion BU said its September sales reached 35,494 vehicles, up 21.91% year over year and marking a seventh consecutive month of growth against the market trend. Orders for the new i60 model surpassed 20,000 in the month. The 2027 Aion i60 launched on September 15 with six variants starting at a limited-time price of 106,800 yuan, while the Aion Ray7 sedan also opened its early-access program.
items.why_zh: 在整体车市承压背景下，连续 7 个月正增长显示出广汽埃安新车周期与定价策略的拉动效果。
items.why_en: With the overall auto market under pressure, seven straight months of growth highlights how GAC Aion's new-model cycle and pricing strategy are driving demand.

items.title_zh: “大空头”伯里：为了人类的利益，市场应该狠跌一次，别让 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 上市
items.title_en: 'Big Short' Investor Burry: Markets Should Crash Hard Enough to Stop OpenAI and Anthropic IPOs
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 1 日消息，据《商业内幕》今天（1 日）凌晨报道，知名做空投资者、《大空头》原型迈克尔 · 伯里认为，如果市场来一场足以阻止 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 上市的暴跌，对人类反而是好事。“ 为了人类的利益，市场应该狠狠跌一场，别让 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 上市 。” 伯里进一步解释称，两家公司会 吸走数万亿美元资金 ，最终再把这些钱毁掉，而这还只是它们可能造成的最小损害。 一名用户调侃称：“把市场砸崩，这样天网就没法上市了。”伯里回复：“差不多就是这个意思。” IT之家注：“天网”指《终结者》系列电影中的毁灭性人工智能系统。 OpenAI CEO 萨姆 · 奥尔特曼本月早些时候称，考虑到 AI 安全问题， 2026 年上市并不明智 。路透社看到的一份招股说明书则显示，Anthropic 很可能在 11 月美国中期选举结束后上市。 开发先进 AI 模型、建设支撑模型运行的计算基础设施，都需要巨额资金。上市后，两家公司可以向更多投资者融资，获得更充足的资本来源。 伯里本周在 Substack 发文称，他比以往任何时候都更确信， 自己的 AI 看空判断会在未来一年兑现 ，此前预计的时间点是 2028 年。 基于这一判断，伯里调整了针对多个标的的看空押注，涵盖英伟达、Palantir、美光科技、甲骨文和纳斯达克 100 指数。 伯里认为，靠举债维持…
items.summary_en: Investor Michael Burry, famous for 'The Big Short,' argued that a market crash severe enough to block OpenAI and Anthropic from going public would benefit humanity, saying the two firms would absorb trillions of dollars and destroy it. He said he is more convinced than ever that his bearish AI call will play out within a year, and adjusted short bets on Nvidia, Palantir, Micron, Oracle and the Nasdaq 100.
items.why_zh: 围绕巨额 AI 资本开支与潜在 IPO 的争议，正成为市场多空双方的核心焦点。
items.why_en: The debate over massive AI capex and looming IPOs has become a central battleground between bulls and bears.

items.title_zh: 马斯克沉寂数月的 AI 维基百科 Grokipedia 推出 v0.3 版本：界面更新，恢复内容编辑
items.title_en: Musk's AI Encyclopedia Grokipedia Ships v0.3 With Redesigned UI and Restored Editing
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 1 日消息，由 SpaceXAI 推出、对标维基百科的人工智能百科项目 Grokipedia 近期重新恢复接收内容编辑。如今该平台又迎来 v0.3 版本更新，进行了多项界面设计调整：启用全新标识，同时对首页与实时编辑页面进行改版。SpaceXAI 的设计负责人本吉 · 泰勒（Benji Taylor）将其称作“焕然一新的 Grokipedia”。 IT之家注意到，Grokipedia 旧版首页基本上只有一个标志和搜索框；改版之后的首页新增了精选条目列表、热门阅读条目列表，还增设了一个追踪板块，可以展示“最新编辑记录”。新版的精选条目区域采用可以旋转的仿真电子书籍样式进行展示；热门阅读板块同样沿用书本的设计隐喻，横向滚动的书架上排列着一排书脊。全新的实时编辑页面现在能够一次性展示更多近期改动，浏览体验有所提升。 条目页面同样做了几处细节优化：位于文章顶部、罗列核心事实的信息表格外观得到改善，正文行间距也有所缩小。除此之外，就目前观察来看，文章主体内容的样式大体上没有发生变化。 该网站最初在 2025 年 10 月末以 v0.1 版本上线，上线之初的大量条目都是由 AI 直接仿制维基百科的页面；时隔一个月之后，平台推出 v0.2 版本更新。但在今年早些时候，Grokipedia 似乎彻底停止了更新工作。Lawfare 在八月份发布的一篇报道当中提到：“就我们目前观察…
items.summary_en: Grokipedia, the AI encyclopedia project from SpaceXAI, has resumed accepting content edits and released version 0.3 with a new logo and redesigned home and live-edit pages. The update adds featured and trending entry lists plus a recent-edits tracker, and improves entry pages. The site launched as v0.1 in late October 2025 with many AI-generated Wikipedia-style entries and had appeared to stop updating earlier this year.
items.why_zh: AI 自动生成内容与人工编辑如何结合，是知识平台可信度的关键考验。
items.why_en: How AI-generated content is combined with human editing is a key test of credibility for knowledge platforms.

items.title_zh: 三星发布其首款夹式耳机 Galaxy Buds On：满电续航 9.5 小时，支持点头 / 摇头控制通话
items.title_en: Samsung Unveils Galaxy Buds On, Its First Clip-On Earbuds With 9.5-Hour Battery and Head-Nod Call Controls
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 1 日消息，三星今天（10 月 1 日）发布公告， 宣布推出其首款耳夹式耳机 Galaxy Buds On，主打户外佩戴舒适与环境音感知。 外观方面，Galaxy Buds On 采用夹式（clip-on）结构，环绕耳廓佩戴，不插入耳道，用户在步行、骑行或跑步时仍可感知环境声音。 佩戴体验方面，三星表示研究了不同耳廓形状，并通过模拟确定扬声器与电池位置，且不断调整耳夹弹性与接触面积，让压力分布更均匀，提升长时间佩戴舒适度。 音质方面，针对开放式耳机的低音响应弱与声音外放问题，三星引入 TwinBoost 扬声器技术来补偿低频，并配备音抑制（Audio Leakage Reduction）功能，限制在咖啡馆、图书馆等场景的声音外泄。 硬件平台采用高通 Snapdragon S7 Gen 1 声音平台，并集成高效率 Class-D 放大器以优化功耗，满电续航最长 9.5 小时音乐播放续航。 通话方面延续 Intelligent Clear Call，结合 3 颗麦克风、骨传导振动传感器（Voice Pickup Unit Sensor）与机器学习方案，分离人声并抑制背景噪声。 AI 交互方面，Galaxy Buds On 与支持 Galaxy AI 的手机或平板联动后，可在双手不便时通过语音完成对话、备忘录与通知查看等操作。 用户说出“Hey Google, let…
items.summary_en: Samsung announced Galaxy Buds On, its first clip-on earbuds designed for outdoor comfort and ambient awareness, with a non-in-ear design. They use TwinBoost speakers to compensate for weak bass, audio-leakage reduction, Qualcomm's Snapdragon S7 Gen 1 sound platform, and up to 9.5 hours of playback, plus Intelligent Clear Call with three mics, a bone-conduction sensor and machine learning. Paired with Galaxy AI devices, they enable voice-driven conversations, memos and notifications.
items.why_zh: 夹式开放式耳机正成为新品类，考验厂商在音质、漏音与佩戴舒适度间的平衡。
items.why_en: Clip-on open-earbuds are emerging as a new category, testing how well vendors balance sound quality, leakage and comfort.

items.title_zh: 当上下文发生变化：理解大语言模型的信息更新失败
items.title_en: When Context Changes: Understanding Update Failures in LLMs
items.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型智能体在偏好、目标与事实发生变化时的失效模式：即使早先版本仍留在上下文中，模型也必须使用最新状态，但它们有时会用同一变量的旧值作答，作者将这种失败称为“陈旧绑定”（stale binding）。为研究模型何时使用过时信息及其原因，作者提出受控上下文记忆（Controlled In-Context Memory, CICM）基准，用于在对话与智能体日志中追踪并使用更新后的信息。研究发现，即使是前沿推理模型也可能无法恢复当前状态；在开源模型中，探针仍可……（摘要原文在此处截断）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.38866v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: As preferences, goals, and facts change, LLM agents must use the current state while earlier versions remain in context. Yet they can answer with an old value of the same variable, a failure that we call stale binding. To study when models use outdated information and why, we introduce Controlled In-Context Memory (CICM), a benchmark for tracking and using updated information in conversations and agent logs. We observe that even frontier reasoning models can fail to recover the current state. We find that in open-source models probes can still re…
items.why_zh: 长期运行的智能体若无法可靠使用最新信息，将直接影响其在真实任务中的可信度。
items.why_en: If long-running agents cannot reliably use the latest information, their trustworthiness in real tasks is undermined.

items.title_zh: 论基于偏好的老虎机问题的复杂性
items.title_en: On the Complexity of Preference-Based Bandits
items.summary_zh: 该论文研究具有一般奖励函数类的基于偏好的老虎机（preference-based bandits）问题：学习者在每一步顺序选择一对臂，并观察由 Bradley–Terry 模型生成的二元偏好反馈。这一设定自然出现在推荐系统、锦标赛排名以及从人类反馈中学习等应用中，因为相对偏好往往比绝对奖励更容易获取。作者指出，该观测模型继承了逻辑老虎机（logistic bandit）中处理问题相关常数 κ 的挑战，该常数刻画了模型的非线性……（摘要原文在此处截断）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.39351v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study preference-based bandits with general reward function classes, where a learner sequentially selects pairs of arms and observes binary preference feedback governed by the Bradley--Terry model. This setting naturally arises in applications such as recommender systems, tournament ranking, and learning from human feedback, where relative preferences are easier to elicit than absolute rewards. The observation model inherits the logistic bandit challenge of handling the problem-dependent constant $\kappa$, which accounts for the non-linearity…
items.why_zh: 相对偏好比绝对奖励更易获得，相关理论分析对 RLHF 与推荐系统的样本效率有直接意义。
items.why_en: Relative preferences are easier to elicit than absolute rewards, so the theory directly bears on sample efficiency in RLHF and recommender systems.

items.title_zh: 分而崩塌：通过精确分解为独立子实例求解 MAPF-Collapse
items.title_en: Divide and Collapse: MAPF-Collapse via Exact Decomposition into Independent Sub-Instances
items.summary_zh: 该论文研究 MAPF-Collapse（MAPFC）问题：给定现代多智能体路径规划（MAPF）求解器产出的可行方案，任务是在保持可行性的前提下删除可避免的多余移动。这一 NP 难问题在学习型最新（SOTA）求解器的使用中自然出现，因为这类求解器生成的方案往往包含冗余移动。Tang 等人此前提出的 Judgelight 使用整数线性规划（ILP）求解 MAPFC，论文指出该 ILP 的……（摘要原文在此处截断）。作者提出的方法是通过精确分解为独立子实例来求解该问题。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.39559v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this work we study the problem of MAPFC, a post-optimization step for Multi-Agent Path Finding (MAPF) plans where we are given a feasible plan produced by a modern MAPF solver and are tasked with removing avoidable moves while preserving feasibility. This NP-hard problem naturally arises when using learning-based state-of-the-art (SOTA) solvers which construct plans that contain redundant moves that can be removed. Recently, Tang et al. presented Judgelight, which uses Integer Linear Programming (ILP) to solve MAPFC. Importantly, the ILP is co…
items.why_zh: 为学习型 MAPF 求解器输出“瘦身”，有助于把冗余方案落地到机器人调度等实际场景。
items.why_en: Trimming redundancy from learning-based MAPF plans helps make them practical for real-world robot scheduling.

items.title_zh: 是牌更好还是裁判不同？评估企业与投资银行场景中的智能体框架增益
items.title_en: Better Deck or Different Judge? Evaluating Agentic Harness Gains in Corporate and Investment Banking
items.summary_zh: 企业与投资银行团队用演示文稿支持信贷决策，并为客户的融资与交易提供建议，制作这类材料需要核对财务数据、追溯来源，并把分析转化为建议。该论文对一套智能体框架（agentic harness）的开发过程进行回顾性研究，该框架结合了一个 27B 参数的语言模型、财务计算、叙述模板与校验检查。研究中由大语言模型担任裁判（LLM judges）来指导工程改动并评估产出的演示文稿，由此引出一个问题：更高的评分究竟反映的是文档质量真的更好，还是只是裁判发生了变化……（摘要原文在此处截断）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.39958v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Corporate and investment banking teams use presentations to support credit decisions and advise clients on financing and transactions. Producing these decks requires reconciling financial data, tracing sources and turning analysis into a recommendation. We retrospectively study the development of an agentic harness combining a 27B language model, financial calculations, narrative templates and validation checks. LLM judges guide engineering changes and assess the resulting decks, raising the question of whether higher scores reflect better docume…
items.why_zh: 当 LLM 裁判同时用于驱动优化和评估时，评分提升可能只是“换了裁判”，这关乎金融等高风险场景的评测可信度。
items.why_en: When LLM judges both drive optimization and evaluate results, score gains may simply reflect a different judge, raising trust concerns for high-stakes domains like finance.

items.title_zh: Janus：让智能体大模型的证据先于效果——可离线验证的来源追溯
items.title_en: Janus: Evidence-Before-Effect Sagas and Offline-Verifiable Provenance for Agentic LLMs
items.summary_zh: 智能体大模型如今能通过工具调动资金等真实资源，但对它们行为的记录通常只是模型自身流程在旁边产出的日志，与真正产生的效果脱钩。Janus 把记录放到了“效果路径”上：某一步的提案、对该提案的裁定，以及验证者或人类给出的任何答复，都必须先被持久写入一个带签名、哈希链式结构的日志中，之后该步骤才能执行、其效果才能被释放；在密钥已声明的条件下，每条答复都由给出或转发它的一方签名。日志上的各个“闸门”是纯函数，审计者可完全离线地从日志中重新推导出每一项裁定。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.38266v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Agentic large language models (LLMs) now move money through tools, yet the record of what they did is usually a trace their own process emits beside the effect. Janus puts the record on the effect path. A step's proposal, the verdict on it and any answer from a validator or a person are durable in a signed, hash-chained log before the step may run or its effect be released; with keys declared, each answer is signed by whoever gave or relayed it. Gates are pure functions of that log, and an auditor re-derives every verdict offline from the log a…
items.why_zh: 它把智能体的可审计性从事后旁证变为执行前的强制前置条件，使外部审计者能离线独立验证机器行为。
items.why_en: It turns agent auditability from after-the-fact side traces into a mandatory precondition for execution, letting outside auditors verify machine actions offline and independently.

items.title_zh: Aegis：面向隐私保护的医疗联邦学习生成式梯度掩蔽
items.title_en: Aegis: Generative Gradient Masking for Privacy-Preserving Medical Federated Learning
items.summary_zh: 联邦学习已成为多机构医疗 AI 的基础范式，让医院与研究中心在不交换患者病历的前提下共同训练诊断模型。但这一隐私承诺正受到挑战：恶意或“诚实但好奇”的服务器可以发动模型反演攻击，直接从共享的模型更新中重建患者的私有影像；近期出现的可扩展闭式攻击在临床现实的批大小下甚至能穿透安全聚合。该论文提出 Aegis，用生成式梯度掩蔽来加强隐私保护，针对现有防御的不足进行改进。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.38339v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Federated learning (FL) has become a foundational paradigm for multi-institutional medical AI, allowing hospitals and research centers to jointly train diagnostic models without exchanging patient records. This privacy promise, however, is increasingly contested: a malicious or honest-but-curious server can launch model inversion attacks (MIAs) that reconstruct private patient images directly from shared model updates, and recent scalable, closed-form attacks penetrate even secure aggregation at clinically realistic batch sizes. Existing defens…
items.why_zh: 若共享梯度可被反演成患者影像，医疗联邦学习的隐私前提将被根本动摇，该工作直接针对这一临床落地风险。
items.why_en: If shared gradients can be inverted into patient images, the privacy premise of medical federated learning collapses, making this a direct response to a real clinical risk.

items.title_zh: 面向 RIS 辅助 B5G 网络的 3GPP 合规基准数据集
items.title_en: A 3GPP-Compliant Benchmark Dataset for RIS-Aided Beyond 5G Networks
items.summary_zh: 可重构智能表面（RIS）正成为后 5G 网络中可编程无线环境的关键技术，但数据驱动的 RIS 研究一直受限于缺乏标准化、高保真且开源的数据集。该论文发布了一个面向 RIS 辅助毫米波网络的大规模数据集，遵循 3GPP TR 38.901 标准，并针对严重路径损耗、对遮挡的敏感性以及空间信道稀疏性等使 RIS 增益更为显著的场景进行建模。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.39058v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Reconfigurable Intelligent Surfaces (RIS) are emerging as a key technology for programmable wireless environments in the beyond the fifth generation (B5G) networks. However, data-driven RIS research remains bottleneck by the lack of standardized, high-fidelity and open-source datasets. In this paper, we introduce a large-scale 3GPP TR 38.901-compliant dataset for RIS-aided millimeter wave (mmWave) networks, that considers severe path loss, blockage sensitivity, and spatial channel sparsity make the RIS assistance more impactful. The dataset spa…
items.why_zh: 标准化开源数据集是数据驱动 RIS 研究可复现与可比对的基础，也是该领域此前最缺的一环。
items.why_en: A standardized, open dataset is the foundation for reproducible and comparable data-driven RIS research, which has been the field's key missing piece.

items.title_zh: 真实代码仓库中的可信运行时错误修复：基准与护栏
items.title_en: Trustworthy Runtime Error Healing in Real-World Repositories: A Benchmark and Guardrail
items.summary_zh: 运行时错误修复通过生成代码来修补程序崩溃时的实时运行状态，使程序得以继续执行。已有研究表明大模型能够生成这类修复代码，但评估仅局限于小型竞赛程序，且在活跃进程中执行大模型生成的代码所带来的安全问题始终未获解决。该论文把基于大模型的运行时修复推向真实仓库场景：首先构建了 HealBench，一个包含来自 18 个真实代码仓库的 265 个运行时错误的基准，每个错误都配有参考修复，并提出了相应的安全护栏。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.39086v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Runtime error healing lets a crashed program continue by generating code that repairs its live runtime state. Recent work shows that LLMs can generate such healing code, but it is evaluated only on small competition programs, and executing LLM-generated code inside a live process raises safety concerns that remain unaddressed. In this paper, we take LLM-based runtime healing toward practical use in real-world repositories. We first build HealBench, a benchmark of 265 runtime errors from 18 real-world repositories, each paired with a reference e…
items.why_zh: 它首次把运行时自修复从竞赛题推向真实仓库，并直面在活跃进程中执行模型生成代码的安全风险。
items.why_en: It moves runtime self-healing from toy competition programs into real repositories while directly confronting the safety risks of executing model-generated code in a live process.

items.title_zh: Ready2Blend：从自然语言指令到可组合的对齐提示
items.title_en: Ready2Blend: From Natural-Language Instructions to Composable Alignment Prompts
items.summary_zh: 持续对齐要求大模型在不遗忘既有行为的前提下适应新要求。自然语言指令灵活且可组合，但只能提供间接控制；后训练虽能带来更强的适配能力，却需要反复更新参数。该论文提出 Ready2Blend，把自然语言的灵活性与已学习的对齐能力结合起来：AlignFormer 将每条要求映射为一个固定长度的对齐提示，存入模块化的提示库中，而主干模型与先前的提示保持冻结。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.39365v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Continual alignment requires LLMs to adapt to new requirements without forgetting previously acquired behaviors. Natural-language instructions are flexible and composable but offer only indirect control, whereas post-training provides stronger adaptation at the cost of repeated parameter updates. We introduce Ready2Blend, which combines the flexibility of natural language with learned alignment. AlignFormer maps each requirement to a fixed-length alignment prompt stored in a modular prompt bank, while the backbone and prior prompts remain froze…
items.why_zh: 它提供了一条无需反复改参数、又能组合多条要求来实现持续对齐的路径。
items.why_en: It offers a route to continual alignment that composes multiple requirements without repeatedly updating model parameters.

items.title_zh: 从语音到可编辑概念：用概念瓶颈模型探究情感识别
items.title_en: From Speech to Editable Concepts: Probing Emotion Recognition with Concept Bottleneck Models
items.summary_zh: 语音情感识别（SER）的任务是为话语赋予情感标签。早期系统依赖声学特征，近期方法则常结合语音与文本等多模态信息，但在许多数据集上性能依然不佳，因此能够联合处理多种输入并接受指令的大语言模型引起了研究者的兴趣。然而，直接输入音频带来了可解释性方面的疑问。针对图像分类中曾出现的类似问题，概念瓶颈模型被引入，该工作将其用于语音情感识别，以概念为中介实现可编辑、可解读的情感判断。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.39453v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Speech emotion recognition (SER) is the task of assigning emotion labels to utterances. Early systems relied on acoustic features, whereas recent approaches combine multiple modalities, most commonly speech and text. Still, performance remains poor on many datasets. Large language models (LLMs) have therefore attracted interest for SER, as they can process diverse inputs jointly with instructions. However, direct audio input raises questions of explainability. To address similar questions in image classification, concept bottleneck models were…
items.why_zh: 它试图解决大模型直接处理音频时“黑箱判断情感”的可解释性难题，让情感结论可由概念中介并加以编辑。
items.why_en: It tackles the explainability gap of LLMs judging emotion directly from audio by mediating decisions through editable concepts.

items.title_zh: WARP：不可见图像水印的统一基准——鲁棒性与抗攻击保护
items.title_en: WARP: A Unified Benchmark for Invisible Image Watermarking -- Robustness and Protection Against Attacks
items.summary_zh: 随着新兴法规与行业实践要求对 AI 生成内容进行标注、并确保来源可追溯以防操纵或滥用，数字图像水印在媒体领域日益关键。不可见水印方法近期取得不少进展，也凸显出现有评测实践需要跟上新技术与新的评价标准。为此，该论文提出 WARP——一个用于评估不可见水印鲁棒性的统一框架与基准，其中纳入了 32 种近期典型方法及相关攻击设定，用以系统衡量水印的稳健性与防护能力。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.40031v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Digital image watermarking is increasingly critical in media contexts, as emerging regulations and industry practices require marking AI-generated content and ensuring traceable sources to prevent manipulation or misuse. Recent advances in invisible watermarking methods highlight the need to update existing benchmarking practices to reflect current techniques and evaluation criteria. We address this by introducing WARP -- a unified framework and benchmark for evaluating the robustness of invisible watermarks. WARP incorporates 32 recent classic…
items.why_zh: 在监管要求标注 AI 生成内容的背景下，一个统一的鲁棒性评测基准直接关系到水印技术能否被信任和落地。
items.why_en: As regulations require marking AI-generated content, a unified robustness benchmark directly determines whether watermarking can be trusted and deployed.

items.title_zh: 把时间序列基础模型锚定到数字孪生拓扑，用于预测性维护
items.title_en: Grounding Time-Series Foundation Models in Digital Twin Topology for Predictive Maintenance
items.summary_zh: 数字孪生越来越多地支撑依赖时间序列数据的下游分析任务，这使时间序列基础模型（TSFM）作为可扩展主干受到关注。但 TSFM 主要以时间延续为目标进行预训练，在回归等未见任务上往往表现不佳，而针对数字孪生场景、与专用最先进模型的系统性实证比较仍然有限。该论文的主要贡献之一，是在剩余使用寿命等任务上用冻结主干对五个知名 TSFM 进行了基准评测。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.40071v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Digital twins increasingly support downstream analytical tasks that depend on time-series data, motivating interest in time-series foundation models (TSFMs) as scalable backbones. However, TSFMs are primarily pretrained for temporal continuation and often underperform on unseen tasks such as regression, and systematic empirical comparisons against state-of-the-art dedicated models in digital twin contexts remain limited. This paper makes three contributions. First, we benchmark five well-known TSFMs with frozen backbones on remaining useful lif…
items.why_zh: 它检验了通用时间序列基础模型能否真正胜任数字孪生中的预测性维护，而不是想当然地当作通用主干使用。
items.why_en: It tests whether general time-series foundation models can actually serve predictive maintenance in digital twins rather than being assumed to work as universal backbones.

items.title_zh: 空间填充曲线就够了：让通信规避型矩阵乘法变简单
items.title_en: Space Filling Curves is All You Need: Communication-Avoiding Matrix Multiplication Made Simple
items.summary_zh: 通用矩阵乘法（GEMM）是高性能计算与深度学习的基石，业界领先的厂商库通过调优张量布局、并行方案和缓存分块，尽量减少数据在内存层级间的搬运以提升吞吐。然而这些参数的最优取值取决于目标平台与矩阵形状，穷举调优并不现实。该工作提出用空间填充曲线（SFC）来划分矩阵乘法，从而绕开繁琐的调度搜索与参数调优，简化通信规避的实现。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2601.16294v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: General Matrix Multiplication (GEMM) is the cornerstone of HPC workloads and Deep Learning. State-of-the-art (SOTA) vendor libraries tune tensor layouts, parallelization schemes and cache blocking to minimize data movement across the memory hierarchy and maximize throughput. However, optimal settings for these parameters depend on the target platform and matrix shapes, making exhaustive tuning infeasible. In this work, we address this cumbersome scheduling search and tuning using space-filling curves (SFC). We partition the matrix multi…
items.why_zh: 用几何曲线替代高昂的自动调优，可能让高性能矩阵乘法在不同硬件上更易部署。
items.why_en: Replacing costly autotuning with a geometric partitioning scheme could make high-performance matrix multiplication easier to deploy across hardware.

items.title_zh: 广义特征空间中的基础模型保持优化（FoLoRA）
items.title_en: Foundation-Preserving Optimization in Generalized Eigenspace
items.summary_zh: 微调能让基础模型适配专门的下游任务，但也会损害预训练阶段获得的非目标任务能力。现有遗忘感知方法通常依靠特殊初始化或固定约束来寻找更安全的更新，却没有在训练过程中调节“适配”与“保持”之间的权衡。作者提出 Foundation Preserving LoRA（FoLoRA），这是一种遗忘感知优化框架：以一阶保持条件为指导，对预训练相关参数定义遗忘惩罚，从而在微调时抑制对原有能力的破坏。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2606.00132v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: While finetuning effectively adapts foundation models to specialized downstream tasks, it can degrade nontarget capabilities acquired during pretraining. Existing forgetting aware methods typically seek safer updates through specialized initialization or fixed constraints, but do not regulate the adaptation preservation trade-off during training. We propose Foundation Preserving LoRA (FoLoRA), a forgetting aware optimization framework. Guided by a first order preservation condition, FoLoRA defines a forgetting penalty over pretraining-p…
items.why_zh: 在微调过程中显式控制遗忘，是让基础模型可安全定制化的关键。
items.why_en: Explicitly regulating forgetting during fine-tuning is key to safely customizing foundation models.

items.title_zh: RamanPFN：用表格基础模型学习拉曼光谱结构
items.title_en: RamanPFN: learning from Raman spectral structure with a tabular foundation model
items.summary_zh: 拉曼光谱可实现无标记的分子表征，广泛用于材料科学、分析化学、生物医学与工业过程监测。但高维光谱的机器学习受限于标注数据稀缺，以及光谱的物理组织方式与“与特征无关”的模型之间的失配——仅做到通道覆盖，并不能保证相关谱带共享同一推理上下文。为此作者提出 RamanPFN，一个通用的光谱基础框架，可实现统一的建模与推理。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.02157v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Raman spectroscopy enables label-free molecular characterization across materials science, analytical chemistry, biomedicine, and industrial process monitoring. However, machine learning for high-dimensional spectroscopy remains constrained by limited labelled data and a mismatch between the physical organization of spectra and feature-agnostic models. Channel coverage alone does not ensure that related bands share a common inference context. Here we present RamanPFN, a general-purpose spectral foundation framework that enables unified…
items.why_zh: 把表格基础模型引入光谱学，有望在标注稀缺条件下统一处理拉曼光谱分析。
items.why_en: Bringing tabular foundation models to spectroscopy could unify Raman analysis under scarce labels.

items.title_zh: AI 聊天机器人能找到专家认可的研究吗？模型、用户角色与样本量对医学问题文献检索的影响
items.title_en: Do AI chatbots find what experts would? Effects of model, user role, and sample size on study retrieval for medical questions
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型聊天机器人越来越多地被用于回答临床问题并附上相关研究引用，但检索到的证据质量以及影响文献选择的因素仍不清楚。研究者选取 20 个改编自 2026 年 Cochrane 综述的临床问题，评估 Claude Sonnet 5、Gemini 3.1 Pro 和 ChatGPT GPT-5.5 三款通用聊天机器人，并模拟患者、临床医生和证据综合研究者三种角色，每个“模型—角色—问题”组合获取四次独立回答。研究据此考察模型、用户角色与样本量对研究检索的影响。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.13786v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Large language model (LLM) chatbots are increasingly used to answer clinical questions with citations to relevant studies, yet the quality of retrieved evidence and factors influencing study selection remain unclear. We evaluated three general-purpose LLM chatbots (Claude Sonnet 5, Gemini 3.1 Pro, and ChatGPT GPT-5.5) using 20 clinical questions adapted from 2026 Cochrane reviews. We simulated patient, clinician, and evidence-synthesis researcher roles and obtained four independent responses for each chatbot-role-question combination, y…
items.why_zh: 厘清聊天机器人检索的医学证据与专家预期的差距，直接关系临床使用的可信度。
items.why_en: Clarifying how chatbot-retrieved medical evidence diverges from expert expectations bears directly on clinical trustworthiness.

items.title_zh: Harness 持续学习：超越模型参数的持续适应
items.title_en: Harness Continual Learning: Continual Adaptation Beyond Model Parameters
items.summary_zh: 持续学习长期以模型为中心，把模型参数视为随序列经验而变化的状态。但现代智能体还能通过由提示、记忆、工具、技能和路由规则构成的“harness”（外挂组件集合）进行适应；这些内容共同决定后续执行，因此即使模型被冻结，harness 的更新也可能破坏此前可靠的行为。作者据此提出 Harness Continual Learning 这一问题设定：智能体如何在模型之外持续改进自身状态，同时保留早先已获得的行为。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.19013v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Continual learning has largely been model-centric, treating model parameters as the state that changes with sequential experience. Modern agents can also adapt through a harness of prompts, memories, tools, skills, and routing rules. Because these contents jointly shape later execution, a harness update can disrupt previously reliable behavior even when the model is frozen. This raises a new question: how can an agent continually improve its state outside the model while retaining behavior acquired earlier? We formulate Harness Continua…
items.why_zh: 把持续学习的研究对象从权重扩展到智能体外围组件，开辟了新的问题空间。
items.why_en: Extending continual learning beyond weights to an agent's external harness opens a new problem space.

items.title_zh: DAMP：衰减感知的混合精度循环状态量化
items.title_en: DAMP: Decay-Aware Mixed-Precision Recurrent-State Quantization
items.summary_zh: 复杂推理与智能体应用日益依赖长上下文推理，不断增长的 KV 缓存同时推高内存占用与解码开销。混合模型通过结合 Softmax Attention 与 Gated DeltaNet（GDN）或 Kimi Delta Attention（KDA）来降低成本，这些机制维护固定大小的循环状态。此类状态通常以 FP32 存储，占用大量 GPU 显存，其更新又受内存带宽限制。量化可以同时减小存储占用与内存流量，但作者发现直接量化会带来问题，因而提出 DAMP 这一衰减感知的混合精度方案。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.27513v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Complex reasoning and agentic applications increasingly rely on long-context inference, where growing KV caches increase both memory usage and decoding overhead. Hybrid models reduce these costs by combining Softmax Attention with Gated DeltaNet (GDN) or Kimi Delta Attention (KDA), which maintain fixed-size recurrent states. These states are commonly stored in FP32 and consume substantial GPU memory, while their updates are limited by memory bandwidth. Quantization can reduce both storage footprint and memory traffic, but we find that u…
items.why_zh: 对循环状态做衰减感知的混合精度量化，是长上下文推理降本增效的关键一环。
items.why_en: Decay-aware mixed-precision quantization of recurrent states is a key lever for cheaper long-context inference.

items.title_zh: LeanPolish：为 Lean 证明压缩提供经过验证的监督
items.title_en: LeanPolish: Verified Supervision for Lean Proof Compression
items.summary_zh: 经过验证的证明编辑是改进语言模型所生成 Lean 证明的天然监督来源，但验证只能说明某次编辑正确，并不能保证其训练信号不含搜索过程的伪影。作者提出 LeanPolish，一个符号化的 Lean 4 流水线，公开发布 33,402 条被接受的局部编辑和 65,596 条同状态下的失败尝试，并用它研究模型能从这类监督中学到什么。研究显示，首次成功搜索会引入与目标无关的规则却能获得完美的排序准确率，教师选定的评估位置也会奖励琐碎内容。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.38384v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Verified proof edits offer a natural source of supervision for improving language-model-generated Lean proofs. Yet verification establishes that an edit is correct, not that its training signal is free of search artifacts. We introduce LeanPolish, a symbolic Lean 4 pipeline that releases 33,402 accepted local edits and 65,596 same-state failed attempts, and use it to study what models learn from this supervision. First-success search admits a goal-independent rule with perfect ranking accuracy; teacher-selected evaluation sites also reward trivia…
items.why_zh: 揭示“已验证”的证明编辑监督中隐藏的搜索伪影，提醒人们警惕训练数据中的质量陷阱。
items.why_en: It exposes hidden search artifacts in supposedly verified proof-edit supervision, warning of quality traps in training data.

items.title_zh: 面向量化循环状态缓存的低差异抖动
items.title_en: Low-Discrepancy Dither for Quantized Recurrent State Caches
items.summary_zh: Mamba 式与混合语言模型将历史压缩进固定大小的循环状态，并在每生成一个 token 时重写该状态。以低精度存储可节省内存带宽，但每次舍入误差都会被反馈进下一次更新，在长文本生成中不断累积。生产系统通常对状态采用随机舍入，作者则追问这类缓存应当使用何种舍入规则。研究发现，一种无需随机数的确定性黄金比例 Weyl 抖动，能稳定地让量化模型更接近全精度结果。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.39185v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Mamba-style and hybrid language models compress their past into a fixed-size recurrent state that is rewritten at every generated token. Storing this state in low precision saves memory bandwidth, but every rounding error is fed back into the next update and can accumulate over long generations. Production systems round the state stochastically; we ask which rounding rule such caches should use. We find that a deterministic golden-ratio Weyl dither, which needs no random numbers, consistently brings the quantized model closer to the full-precisio…
items.why_zh: 一个无需随机数的舍入规则，可能显著改善长生成场景下量化循环状态的稳定性与质量。
items.why_en: A random-number-free rounding rule may markedly improve the stability and quality of quantized recurrent states in long generations.

items.title_zh: 何时而非多少：在稀疏事件上评估时间序列基础模型
items.title_en: When, Not How Much: Evaluating Time-Series Foundation Models on Sparse Events
items.summary_zh: 这篇论文指出，预训练时间序列基础模型（TSFM）通常被当作未来数值的预测器来评估，但在稀疏序列中，许多决策只取决于未来哪些时段存在活动，而标准基准并不考察这一点。作者在五个稀疏数据集上，对同时包含事件与零值的预测窗口内部位置进行排序评估。结果显示，12 个 TSFM 发布的点预测在机会校正平均精度上相比无需训练的参考方法最多只提升 0.031；在机会校正 AUC 指标上，中位数 TSFM 在每个数据集上都低于参考方法。研究提示，现有 TSFM 在“何时发生”这类稀疏事件定位任务上表现有限。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.39386v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Pretrained time-series foundation models (TSFMs) are evaluated as forecasters of future values, yet for sparse series many decisions depend only on which future periods contain activity. Standard benchmarks do not assess this. On five sparse datasets, we rank positions within forecast windows that contain both events and zeros. The released point forecasts of 12 TSFMs improve chance-corrected average precision over training-free references by at most 0.031, and in chance-corrected AUC the median TSFM falls below them on every dataset. With event…
items.why_zh: 它揭示了时间序列基础模型在稀疏事件“何时发生”的定位任务上并不优于简单参考方法，提示现有评估基准存在盲区。
items.why_en: It shows that time-series foundation models fail to beat simple references at locating when sparse events occur, exposing a blind spot in current benchmarks.

items.title_zh: 面向开放权重大模型的城市网络空间上下文检索：地理推理忠实度基准
items.title_en: Network-based Spatial Context Retrieval for Open-weight LLMs: A Faithfulness Benchmark for Grounded Geographic Reasoning
items.summary_zh: 论文指出，大语言模型虽蕴含大量潜在地理知识，但空间推理能力较差，仅凭坐标查询时结果不可靠，只有在提示中提供结构化空间上下文时才会出现有用行为。由此引出一个地理评估尚未考察的问题：当正确的上下文被提供后，模型究竟是基于上下文推理，还是用自身参数化记忆覆盖它？作者提出一套基于网络的开放空间上下文检索流程，并以此为基准考察模型的忠实度，用以判断模型在地理推理中是否真正依据外部提供的空间信息作答。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.39437v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) encode substantial latent geographic knowledge, yet they reason poorly over space and are unreliable when queried from coordinates alone. Useful behaviour emerges only when structured spatial context is supplied in the prompt. This raises a question geographic evaluation has left unexamined: once the right context is supplied, does the model reason from it, or override it with its own parametric recall? We take up this question with an open pipeline for network-based spatial context retriev-al. In it, the surroundings…
items.why_zh: 它把评估焦点从“模型知道多少地理知识”转向“模型是否忠实使用所给空间上下文”，为可信地理推理提供了新的衡量方式。
items.why_en: It shifts geographic evaluation from what models know to whether they faithfully use provided spatial context, offering a new measure for trustworthy geographic reasoning.

items.title_zh: 在不完美先验下学习可靠的 GUI 智能体
items.title_en: Learning Reliable GUI Agents under Imperfect Priors
items.summary_zh: 论文指出，基于大语言模型和视觉语言模型的 GUI 智能体在未见应用和复杂多步任务上仍表现不佳，原因是完成真实 GUI 任务依赖应用专属且随时间快速变化的操作知识，而这类知识在预训练语料中十分稀缺。检索增强执行是自然的补救思路，但面临两个相互耦合的瓶颈：大规模知识难以获取；自采集的先验会因版本更新、推广、广告、A/B 测试和个性化而不可避免地偏离真实运行环境。作者据此提出在该条件下提升 GUI 智能体可靠性的研究方向。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.39547v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: GUI agents built on large language and vision-language models still struggle on unseen applications and complex multi-step tasks, as completing real GUI tasks depends on app-specific, temporally volatile operational knowledge that is scarce in pretraining corpora. Retrieval-augmented execution offers a natural remedy but faces two coupled bottlenecks: knowledge at scale is hard to acquire, and self-collected priors inevitably drift from the live environment due to version updates, promotions, ads, A/B tests, and personalization. We therefore argu…
items.why_zh: 它点明了 GUI 智能体落地时“知识获取难＋先验持续漂移”这一耦合难题，为构建可靠智能体划出了关键研究边界。
items.why_en: It highlights the coupled bottlenecks of hard-to-acquire knowledge and constantly drifting priors that stand in the way of reliable GUI agents in real deployments.

items.title_zh: 超越均匀压缩：面向极端联邦学习的预算化传输分配
items.title_en: Beyond Uniform Compression: Budgeted Transmission Allocation for Extreme Federated Learning
items.summary_zh: 联邦学习在客户端上传高维模型更新时面临严重通信瓶颈，而现有方法通常对所有层做均匀压缩，忽略了不同参数块价值的异质性，把有限带宽浪费在不敏感的层上。为此作者提出逐层预算自适应传输（LBAT），把极端上行带宽预算下的联邦通信重新表述为资源分配问题。该框架动态估计各层的传输价值并据此分配带宽，从而在相同通信预算下更有效地保留对模型性能关键的参数信息。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.39646v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Federated learning faces severe communication bottlenecks when clients upload high-dimensional model updates. Existing methods often compress these updates uniformly across all layers. This uniform approach ignores the heterogeneous value of different parameter blocks and wastes limited bandwidth on insensitive layers. To address this issue, we propose Layer-wise Budgeted Adaptive Transmission (LBAT). LBAT reframes federated communication under extreme uplink budgets as a resource allocation problem. Our framework dynamically estimates the transm…
items.why_zh: 它把联邦通信压缩从“一刀切”改为按层分配带宽预算，有望在极端上行受限场景下显著提升通信效率。
items.why_en: It replaces one-size-fits-all compression with layer-wise bandwidth budgeting, potentially improving efficiency under extreme uplink constraints in federated learning.

items.title_zh: Nixtlaverse：一个开源的预测生态系统
items.title_en: The Nixtlaverse: An Open-Source Ecosystem for Forecasting
items.summary_zh: 大型预测应用往往同时结合统计模型、机器学习模型和神经网络模型。这些模型族解决同一问题，但在拟合状态、训练流程和并行化方式上各不相同。因此预测软件要么用统一的估计器接口隐藏这些差异，要么把它们分散到不同软件包中，迫使用户为每个包重写数据准备与评估代码。论文以 Nixtlaverse 为例，介绍了一个面向时间序列预测的开源 Python 库生态系统，用以在保留各模型族差异的同时统一数据处理与评估流程。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.39741v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large forecasting applications often combine statistical, machine-learning, and neural models. These families solve the same problem but differ in fitted state, training procedures, and how they parallelize work. Forecasting software must therefore either hide these differences behind a single estimator interface, or keep the families in separate packages, forcing users to rewrite data preparation and evaluation for every package. We present the Nixtlaverse, an ecosystem of open-source Python libraries for time series forecasting, as a case study…
items.why_zh: 它为多模型族共存的预测工作流提供了统一的开源生态方案，可减少用户在数据准备与评估上的重复劳动。
items.why_en: It offers a unified open-source ecosystem for workflows mixing multiple forecasting model families, reducing duplicated data preparation and evaluation effort.

items.title_zh: 通过梯度封堵实现预防性 LLM 遗忘，阻止禁用能力被获取
items.title_en: Preemptive LLM Unlearning against Forbidden Capability Acquisition via Gradient Sealing
items.summary_zh: 开放权重的大模型不仅是固定产品，也可作为下游微调的基础，这种开放性带来了法律与伦理风险：用户可能滥用微调来注入非法知识或支持敌对操作。因此模型提供方需要在发布前部署防御手段，这引出了“预防性遗忘”问题。与移除固定模型中已有能力的回溯式遗忘不同，预防性遗忘旨在阻止模型在未知的下游微调条件下获得这些能力。论文提出通过梯度封堵的方法来实现这一目标。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.39866v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Open-weight LLMs are released not only as fixed products but also as substrates for downstream fine-tuning. This openness, however, creates legal and ethical risks because users may misuse fine-tuning to instill illicit knowledge or enable hostile operations. Model providers therefore need apre-release defense against such acquisition, motivating the problem of preemptive unlearning. Unlike retrospective unlearning, which removes capabilities already present in a fixed model, preemptive unlearning seeks to prevent their acquisition under unseen a…
items.why_zh: 它把遗忘从“事后删除能力”推进到“发布前阻止能力被微调获得”，为开放权重模型的安全发布提供了新思路。
items.why_en: It advances unlearning from removing existing capabilities to preventing their acquisition through fine-tuning, offering a new safeguard for releasing open-weight models.

items.title_zh: 个性化 AI 中的隐私是系统属性，而非仅仅是模型属性
items.title_en: Privacy in Personalized AI Is a System Property, Not Just a Model Property
items.summary_zh: 在对话助手、推荐系统等个性化 AI 应用中，用户并非与孤立的模型交互，而是与更广泛的系统交互，这些系统会跨组件、跨时间地访问、推断并复用用户信息。这种对用户信息的使用是个性化的必要组成部分，但也带来了重要的隐私问题。作者主张，仅停留在单个模型或组件层面的分析可能无法覆盖此类系统中出现的全部隐私风险，因此需要从系统层面审视隐私，并在文中对相关概念做了区分。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.38289v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In personalized AI applications, such as conversational assistants and recommender systems, users interact not with models in isolation but with broader systems that access, infer, and reuse user information across components and over time. While such use of user information is integral to personalization, it also raises important privacy questions. In this paper, we argue that individual model- or component-level analyses may not capture all privacy risks arising in such systems, motivating a system-level perspective on privacy. We distinguish…
items.why_zh: 它提醒隐私风险往往在系统层面产生，仅审计单个模型可能低估个性化 AI 的真实隐私代价。
items.why_en: It warns that privacy risks often emerge at the system level, so auditing individual models alone may understate the true privacy cost of personalized AI.

items.title_zh: 公平性剧场：评估供应商控制的预警系统中的事后公平干预
items.title_en: Fairness Theatre: Evaluating Post-Hoc Fairness Interventions in Vendor-Controlled Early Warning Systems
items.summary_zh: 公共机构越来越多地采购其无法审查或修改设计的 AI 系统。在高等教育领域，专有预警系统（EWS）让高校除了调整模型输出之外几乎没有别的选择来应对不公平问题。这引出一个问题：在供应商、院校、导师与学生之间改变系统的权力并不对等的情况下，公平工作究竟如何协调？作者使用加拿大安大略省一所公立高校的学生记录，在模拟采购条件下对一个研究用预警系统评估了六种事后公平干预措施。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.38552v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Public institutions increasingly procure AI systems whose design they cannot inspect or change. In higher education, proprietary Early Warning Systems (EWS) leave colleges with few options beyond adjusting model outputs to address inequity. This raises the question of how fairness work is coordinated among vendors, institutions, advisors, and students with unequal power to change these systems? Using student records from a public college in Ontario, Canada, we evaluate six post-hoc fairness interventions on a research EWS under simulated procur…
items.why_zh: 它揭示了在供应商掌控设计的采购场景中，事后公平调整可能只是“公平性剧场”，难以真正改变系统性的不公平。
items.why_en: It suggests that post-hoc fairness adjustments in vendor-controlled procurement may amount to "fairness theatre" that fails to address systemic inequity.

items.title_zh: PrivCert：在差分隐私下认证陈述支持度
items.title_en: PrivCert: Certifying Statement Support under Differential Privacy
items.summary_zh: 这篇 arXiv 论文指出现有差分隐私（DP）文本生成存在“证据缺口”：隐私保护本身并不能说明所发布内容在多大程度上得到原始数据的支持，一份隐私报告可能包含看似合理、实则缺乏数据支撑的陈述。为此，作者提出 PrivCert 框架，通过隐私保护证书和“发布或弃权”（emit-or-abstain）决策，让陈述的支持程度变得显式可查，并给出了一种典型的实例化方式。该工作试图在保护个体记录的同时，为生成内容的可信度提供可验证的依据。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.38934v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Differentially private (DP) text generation can protect individual records, but privacy alone does not specify what evidence a released statement carries about the underlying data. We identify this as an evidence gap: a private report may contain plausible claims without indicating whether they are strongly supported by the private dataset. We introduce PrivCert, a framework for privacy-preserving reporting that makes statement support explicit through privacy-preserving certificates and emit-or-abstain decisions. As a canonical instantiation,…
items.why_zh: 为差分隐私生成的文本补上“可信度验证”这一环，让隐私保护与内容可信不再二选一。
items.why_en: It closes the trust gap in differentially private generation by making the evidential support behind released statements verifiable.

items.title_zh: 迈向更高效、鲁棒、实例自适应且可泛化的序列决策
items.title_en: Towards More Efficient, Robust, Instance-adaptive, and Generalizable Sequential Decision making
items.summary_zh: 这是一篇博士论文的 arXiv 替换版本，作者的目标是为不确定性下数据驱动的序列决策设计既有理论保证又实用的算法。研究聚焦强化学习（RL）、多臂老虎机及其在推荐系统、计算机网络、视频分析和大型语言模型（LLM）等方向的应用。文中指出，老虎机与 RL 等方法已取得显著成功，从在 Atari、围棋等复杂游戏中超越人类玩家，到推动机器人学等领域的进展。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2504.09192v5 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The primary goal of my Ph.D. study is to develop provably efficient and practical algorithms for data-driven sequential decision-making under uncertainty. My work focuses on reinforcement learning (RL), multi-armed bandits, and their applications, including recommendation systems, computer networks, video analytics, and large language models (LLMs). Sequential decision-making methods, such as bandits and RL, have demonstrated remarkable success - ranging from outperforming human players in complex games like Atari and Go to advancing robotics…
items.why_zh: 系统梳理了如何构建既有理论保证又能落地的序列决策算法这一核心研究方向。
items.why_en: It summarizes research directions for building theoretically grounded yet practical sequential decision-making algorithms.

items.title_zh: 面向稀疏斜向森林的向量化动态直方图
items.title_en: Vectorized Dynamic Histograms for Sparse Oblique Forests
items.summary_zh: 稀疏斜向（SPO）是谷歌 Yggdrasil 决策森林（YDF）顶级配置的组成部分，它通过扫描特征的稀疏线性组合而非单一特征，在提升随机森林（RF）与梯度提升树（GBT）精度的同时保持可解释性。由于投影在运行时采样，无法采用预排序等预跑优化，训练速度明显偏慢。作者对 YDF 中的 SPO 训练进行全面改造：先修复已发布版本中的低效问题，取得 2-5 倍加速，并进一步提出向量化动态直方图方法。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2603.00326v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Sparse oblique (SPO), part of the top-ranked configuration of Google's Yggdrasil Decision Forests (YDF), improve the accuracy while maintaining interpretability of Random Forests (RF) and Gradient Boosted Trees (GBT) by scanning a sparse linear combination of features instead of a single feature. Because projections are sampled at runtime, training is significantly slower, as pre-run optimizations such as presorting cannot be used. We overhaul SPO training in YDF, first by fixing inefficiencies in the released version, achieving 2-5x speedup,…
items.why_zh: 为谷歌 YDF 中兼顾精度与可解释性的顶级配置带来 2-5 倍训练加速。
items.why_en: It delivers 2-5x faster training for a top-performing, interpretable forest configuration used in Google's YDF.

items.title_zh: “好奇号”探索运行超 5000 个火星日，美国宇航局发布“火星明信片”

items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 1 日消息，科技媒体 scitechdaily 昨日（9 月 30 日）发布博文， 报道称美国宇航局（NASA）为庆祝“好奇号”（Curiosity）火星车运行超过 5,000 个火星日，推出一组特别的全景影像，被形容为“火星明信片”。 好奇号于 2012 年 8 月 6 日降落在火星盖尔陨石坑（Gale Crater），开始原定约 2 年的任务，于 2026 年 8 月 29/30 日（不同媒体报道存在差异）左右达到第 5,000 个火星日。 美国宇航局官方账号 @NASAMars 于 9 月 2 日在 X 平台发布推文，宣布“好奇号”已在火星表面探索超过 5,000 个火星日（sol）。由于 1 个火星日约为 24 小时 39 分钟，因此 5,000 个火星日相当于超过 5,137 个地球日，也就是超过 14 个地球年。 美国宇航局任务团队为庆祝该里程碑，发布了一组特别的全景影像，第一组全景拍摄于火星当地时间上午 9:56（第 5,000 sol），第二组拍摄于当天下午 5:39（第 5,003 sol）。 拍摄地点位于夏普山（Mount Sharp）下部山麓附近的一处沙质山脊，任务团队将其昵称为“Chocolatal”（巧克力），两张全景分别代表清晨与黄昏的光照条件。IT之家附上相关图片如下： 参考 点击这里可以前往美国宇航局官网，下载“好奇号”火星车相关…
items.summary_en: NASA released special panoramic images dubbed "postcards from Mars" to mark the Curiosity rover surpassing 5,000 sols on the Red Planet. Because a sol lasts about 24 hours 39 minutes, that equals more than 5,137 Earth days, or over 14 Earth years — far beyond its original roughly two-year mission.
items.why_zh: 这一里程碑凸显火星车的超期服役能力，新影像也为盖尔陨石坑提供了新的观测视角。
items.why_en: The milestone shows the rover's longevity far beyond its planned mission, while the imagery offers fresh views of Gale Crater.

items.title_zh: 生物安全领域里程碑：谷歌 DeepMind 首创 AI 蛋白质水印技术
items.title_en: Biosecurity Milestone: Google DeepMind Debuts AI Protein Watermarking
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 30 日消息，谷歌今日推出 SynthID Bio ，将数字水印技术引入合成生物学领域。该技术可将不可感知的签名直接嵌入生物编码，不仅能在数字模型上验证， 还可在合成的物理蛋白质上完成验证，同时在实验室测试中保持蛋白质的生物学功能。 生成式 AI 正在帮助科学家解决关键生物学挑战，从预测蛋白质结构到设计全新蛋白质，再到开发新型噬菌体。但这类工具也带来了新挑战：新型 AI 设计可能绕过传统 DNA 合成筛选， 而标记错误的合成 3D 结构会污染公共数据库，误导后续研究。 SynthID Bio 是专门为合成生物学开发的水印方法系列，旨在加强生物安全和科学诚信。 它会根据数据类型调整方法，对序列的氨基酸选择进行 subtle 引导，对预测的 3D 结构调整原子坐标，从而创建可靠的检测信号。实验表明，这些调整不会损害蛋白质的生物学功能，这对于有效治疗疾病和推进科学研究至关重要。 在针对 VEGF-A、SARS-CoV-2 刺突蛋白 RBD 和 PD-L1 这三种靶蛋白的湿实验室测试中，带水印的设计在命中率、结合亲和力和自然序列多样性方面，与未带水印的版本表现一致，成功创造了首个带有水印且具备生物学功能的蛋白质结合剂。 对于蛋白质折叠， SynthID Bio 对 AlphaFold 3 扩散网络的一小部分进行微调，将水印能力直接构建到模型权重中。这确保预测的 3D 坐标…
items.summary_en: Google introduced SynthID Bio, which embeds imperceptible signatures into biological code that can be verified in both digital models and synthesized physical proteins while preserving function. Wet-lab tests on VEGF-A, the SARS-CoV-2 spike RBD and PD-L1 showed watermarked designs matched unwatermarked versions in hit rate, binding affinity and natural sequence diversity.
items.why_zh: 在生成式 AI 加速进入生物学之际，为生物安全与科学诚信提供了可验证的标记手段。
items.why_en: Watermarking biological designs could strengthen biosecurity and scientific integrity as generative AI spreads in biology.

items.summary_zh: DeepSeek开源昇腾组件，联手华为分散英伟达依赖 手机新浪网
items.summary_en: DeepSeek has open-sourced components for Huawei's Ascend platform and is working with Huawei to reduce its reliance on Nvidia. The move pushes Chinese model developers further toward a domestic AI chip ecosystem.
items.why_zh: 国产大模型与国产芯片加速绑定，直接挑战英伟达在中国 AI 供应链中的主导地位。
items.why_en: DeepSeek and Huawei teaming up accelerates China's shift away from Nvidia in the AI supply chain.

items.title_zh: DeepSeek开源昇腾基础组件，华为给予毫无保留支持
items.title_en: DeepSeek Open-Sources Ascend Base Components, Huawei Offers Unreserved Support
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek开源昇腾基础组件，华为给予毫无保留支持 手机新浪网
items.summary_en: DeepSeek has open-sourced Ascend base components, with Huawei expressing full support. This move may boost the Ascend AI ecosystem and promote domestic AI hardware-software collaboration.
items.why_zh: 有助于国产 AI 芯片生态与开源社区发展。
items.why_en: It supports the development of China's domestic AI chip ecosystem.

items.title_zh: FTC 对 OpenAI、Anthropic 等 AI 实验室发起大规模消费者保护调查
items.title_en: FTC launches sweeping probe into OpenAI, Anthropic, and other AI labs over consumer protection concerns
items.summary_zh: 据 the-decoder 报道，美国联邦贸易委员会（FTC）对 OpenAI、Anthropic 及其他 AI 实验室发起大规模调查，重点关注消费者保护问题。报道未披露调查的具体条款与时间表，但“消费者保护”通常指向用户数据使用、产品宣传与用户权益等环节。若调查升级，可能波及多家前沿 AI 公司的商业实践与合规安排，也意味着 FTC 的审查范围已从个别公司扩展到整个行业。
items.summary_en: FTC launches sweeping probe into OpenAI, Anthropic, and other AI labs over consumer protection concerns the-decoder.com
items.why_zh: FTC 的审查从个别公司扩大到多家 AI 实验室，行业性合规压力明显上升。
items.why_en: The FTC widening its scrutiny from one company to multiple AI labs raises industry-wide compliance pressure.

items.title_zh: 比尔·盖茨警告 AI 落入坏人手中可能致“十亿人死亡”，称 Kill Switch 与行业自律远远不够
items.title_en: 'A billion deaths': Bill Gates warns about AI in the wrong hands, saying a kill switch and self-regulation won’t be enough
items.summary_zh: 据《财富》报道，比尔·盖茨就人工智能的滥用风险发出严厉警告，提出 AI 一旦落入坏人之手，后果可能是“十亿人死亡”级别的灾难。他认为，仅仅依靠一个“终止开关”（kill switch）以及行业自我监管，都不足以防范这类极端风险。此番表态出现在全球头部 AI 企业与监管机构围绕安全治理持续博弈的背景下，也呼应了业界对前沿模型被恶意使用的高度担忧。
items.summary_en: 'A billion deaths': Bill Gates warns about AI in the wrong hands, saying a kill switch and self-regulation won’t be enough fortune.com
items.why_zh: 顶级科技人物公开以“十亿人死亡”量级描述 AI 滥用风险，凸显安全治理不能只靠企业自律。
items.why_en: A top tech figure publicly framing AI misuse as a billion-death risk underscores that safety cannot rest on self-regulation alone.

items.title_zh: Meta Muse AI 代理最新动态汇总
items.title_en: All the latest news on Meta’s cute, creepy Muse AI agent
items.summary_zh: Meta 推出了新的 Muse AI 代理，宣称能帮用户处理从发邮件到在线购物等各类事务；报道称，只要用户愿意把数据交给 Meta 并授权它使用信用卡，Muse 的执行效果“出人意料地好”。发布后 Meta 还宣布了形似电子宠物 Tamagotchi 的 Muse Charm 设备计划，用于其 AI 吉祥物，并把 Muse 工具扩展到小企业，同时将通过 Meta Enterprise Platform 把 Muse AI 带给企业客户。不过报道也提到，Muse 曾把一名 YouTuber 的住址发送给陌生人，凸显其隐私风险。
items.summary_en: Meta launched a new Muse AI agent it claims can help you with everything from firing off emails to buying stuff online. Muse can be surprisingly effective at delivering on those promises — if you’re willing to trust Meta with your data and hand Muse your credit card. Since the launch, Meta’s also announced plans for a Tamagotchi-like Muse Charm device for its cuddly AI mascot. Follow along here for the latest news and updates. Meta’s Muse AI sent a YouTuber’s address to a stranger Meta expands Muse tools for small businesses. Meta Enterprise Platform will bring its Muse AI to businesses.…
items.why_zh: Muse 同时展示了 AI 代理的便利与隐私风险，也显示 Meta 正把 AI 助手推向消费硬件与企业市场。
items.why_en: Muse highlights the trade-off between agent convenience and privacy risk as Meta pushes AI assistants into consumer hardware and enterprise.

items.title_zh: 豆包个人助理“小豆”拟推出独立App，目前仍在内测
items.title_en: Doubao's Personal Assistant 'Xiaodou' May Get a Standalone App, Still in Beta
items.summary_zh: 豆包个人助理“小豆”拟推出独立App，目前仍在内测 动点科技
items.summary_en: Doubao's personal assistant "Xiaodou" is planning a standalone app and remains in internal testing, according to TechNode. No launch date or full feature details have been announced.
items.why_zh: 字节若为个人助理单独设 App，意味着 C 端 AI 助手竞争进入更细分的阶段。
items.why_en: A standalone assistant app would show ByteDance pushing competition in consumer AI assistants into more specialized segments.

items.title_zh: 谷歌据报试点向出版商付费，为 AI 搜索结果中的内容贡献买单
items.title_en: Google reportedly tests paying publishers for AI search results
items.summary_zh: 据 The Information 报道，谷歌已启动一项试点项目，向为其 AI 搜索功能提供内容贡献的出版商付费，参与方约 100 家。该试点由 Digiday 最早披露，启动至今不到一年。报道称，谷歌会根据出版商内容对搜索中的 AI Overviews、AI Mode 以及 Gemini 聊天机器人的贡献程度进行支付。此举正值谷歌因 AI 功能对网站流量造成冲击而受到外界审视之际，被视为其与内容方重新分配价值的一种尝试。
items.summary_en: Google has launched a pilot program that pays publishers for their contributions to its AI-powered search features, according to a report from The Information . The pilot program reportedly includes around 100 publishers and comes as Google faces scrutiny over the impact of its AI features on web traffic. Digiday first reported on the pilot program , which began less than a year ago. As part of the test, Google is reportedly paying participating publishers for how much their content contributed to AI Overviews and AI Mode in Search, as well as its Gemini chatbot. One publisher that joined the…
items.why_zh: 若付费模式成形，可能重塑 AI 搜索时代内容方与平台之间的流量和收益分配规则。
items.why_en: If the payment model sticks, it could reshape how traffic and revenue are split between publishers and platforms in the AI search era.

items.title_zh: OpenAI 推出 Muse 竞品，Meta 被视为个人 AI 智能体之战“明显领跑者”
items.title_en: OpenAI Launches Muse Competitor. Meta Seen As 'Clear Leader' In Personal AI Agent Battle.
items.summary_zh: 据《投资者商业日报》报道，OpenAI 推出了对标 Muse 的产品，加入个人 AI 智能体的竞争。报道同时称，在这场个人 AI 智能体的角逐中，Meta 被业界视为“明显的领跑者”。这反映出各大科技公司正围绕可替用户自主执行任务的个人 AI 助手加快布局，竞争焦点从模型能力转向智能体的落地与生态。
items.summary_en: OpenAI Launches Muse Competitor. Meta Seen As 'Clear Leader' In Personal AI Agent Battle. Investor's Business Daily
items.why_zh: 个人 AI 智能体被视为下一阶段入口之争，谁领跑将影响用户与生态的归属。
items.why_en: Personal AI agents are shaping up as the next platform battleground, so who leads could determine user and ecosystem lock-in.

items.title_zh: 曝美国联邦贸易委员会对 Anthropic、OpenAI 及其他 AI 实验室加大调查力度
items.title_en: FTC Ramps Up Probe Into Anthropic, OpenAI and Other Frontier AI Labs, Plans to Compel Executive Testimony
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 30 日消息，据纽约邮报消息，政府官员透露，美国联邦贸易委员会 FTC 正在加大对 Anthropic、OpenAI 及其他前沿人工智能实验室的全面调查力度， 旨在彻查其技术可能对消费者造成的潜在风险 。FTC 计划向这些科技巨头下达类似于传票的正式要求，强制其提交相关信息。 2026 年 7 月，Hugging Face 的人工智能开源社区遭遇 OpenAI 智能体入侵。据悉，FTC 主席安德鲁 · 弗格森（Andrew N. Ferguson）早在此次事件发生前就已启动相关调查，目前该机构正进一步起草民事调查传令，拟依法强制传唤各头部 AI 企业的高管提供证词。 一位 FTC 高级官员表示：“ FTC 计划依法强制传唤这些企业的高管 ，要求其就自身产品情况，以及此前各方指称其产品可能对广大消费者乃至全美公众构成的潜在威胁，如实提供证言。” 据IT之家此前报道，本周二，多家顶尖 AI 企业的掌门人 —— 包括 Anthropic 的达里奥 · 阿莫迪 (Dario Amodei)、OpenAI 的萨姆 · 奥尔特曼 (Sam Altman)、谷歌的桑达尔 · 皮查伊 (Sundar Pichai) 以及 xAI 的埃隆 · 马斯克 (Elon Musk)—— 齐聚白宫共同签署协议， 承诺将对各自的人工智能模型实施自主监管与安全自律 。 弗格森此前曾多次公开表态，…
items.summary_en: The FTC is expanding its investigation into Anthropic, OpenAI and other frontier AI labs over potential consumer risks, planning subpoena-like demands and civil investigative demands to compel executive testimony, per the New York Post. The escalation comes days after AI CEOs signed a White House pledge on self-regulation and safety.
items.why_zh: 监管机构以强制传唤方式介入，标志着前沿 AI 安全治理正从企业自愿承诺走向法律强制约束。
items.why_en: Compelled testimony signals a shift in frontier AI governance from voluntary corporate pledges toward enforceable legal oversight.

items.title_zh: AI debt surge raises risk of sharp market correction, warns Bank of England
items.title_en: AI Debt Surge Raises Risk of Sharp Market Correction, Warns Bank of England
items.summary_zh: AI debt surge raises risk of sharp market correction, warns Bank of England Financial Times
items.summary_en: The Bank of England warns that a surge in AI-related debt raises the risk of a sharp market correction. The warning highlights concerns over financial stability amid the AI investment boom.
items.why_zh: 提示 AI 投资过热可能引发系统性金融风险。
items.why_en: It signals potential systemic risks from overheating AI investments.

items.title_zh: 8899 元起：三星 Galaxy Tab S12+/S12 Ultra 平板发布，天玑 9500 芯片、12.6/14.6 英寸 AMOLED 大屏
items.title_en: Samsung Galaxy Tab S12+ and S12 Ultra Debut With Dimensity 9500 and Up to 14.6-Inch AMOLED, From 8,899 Yuan
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 30 日消息，三星电子今天宣布推出 Galaxy Tab S12 系列平板，包含 Tab S12+ 和 Tab S12 Ultra 两个机型，国内售价 8899 元 / 10499 元起。两款机器均采用轻薄设计，提供更强性能和全新 AI 功能，10 月 7 日起陆续在全球各地上市。 京东 三星 Samsung Galaxy Tab S12+ 8899 元 直达链接 京东 三星 Samsung Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra 10499 元 直达链接 据介绍，三星 Galaxy Tab S12 系列平板配备沉浸式显示屏，附赠符合人体工学设计的 S Pen 手写笔，可轻松记录笔记，满足工作和学习要求。其中，Tab S12 Ultra 机身厚度仅 5.1mm，是三星迄今为止最薄的平板。 规格方面，Galaxy Tab S12+ 平板配备 12.6 英寸屏幕，Ultra 提供 14.6 英寸大屏。两款机型均为 AMOLED 2X 屏幕，最高亮度可达 1600nits，可在室外呈现清晰画面。配备四扬声器系统，支持空间音频，带来更加沉浸的观影、听音体验。 同时，Galaxy Tab S12 系列平板均配备天玑 9500 芯片，海外机型最高可选 16GB 内存、1TB 存储，支持 microSD 卡扩容。新机采用全新 3D 均热板，为长时间高负载工作提供充足散热，具备…
items.summary_en: Samsung unveiled the Galaxy Tab S12+ and Tab S12 Ultra, priced from 8,899 and 10,499 yuan in China and rolling out globally from October 7. Both use the Dimensity 9500 chip, AMOLED 2X displays up to 1600 nits, quad speakers, an S Pen and new AI features, with the Ultra measuring just 5.1mm thick.
items.why_zh: 超薄机身、旗舰芯片与新增 AI 功能，显示安卓平板正以生产力与 AI 体验争夺高端市场。
items.why_en: Ultra-thin designs plus flagship chips and AI features show Android tablets competing for the premium productivity market.

items.title_zh: Corvex 推出面向开放权重模型的安全优先 AI 推理平台
items.title_en: Corvex Launches Security-First AI Inference Platform for Open-Weight Models
items.summary_zh: 据 PR Newswire 消息，Corvex 发布了一款“安全优先”的 AI 推理平台，面向开放权重（open-weight）模型。该平台主打在推理环节强化安全性，服务希望自行部署开源模型的企业与开发者。在开源模型快速普及、企业对数据与合规愈发敏感的背景下，安全导向的推理基础设施正成为新的竞争点。
items.summary_en: Corvex Launches Security-First AI Inference Platform for Open-Weight Models PR Newswire
items.why_zh: 开源模型普及后，安全与合规正成为推理层新的差异化卖点。
items.why_en: As open-weight models spread, security and compliance are becoming key differentiators at the inference layer.

items.title_zh: B站开源 Index-Translate 多语言翻译模型家族，文本模型支持 150 种语言
items.title_en: Bilibili Open-Sources Index-Translate Model Family, Text Models Cover 150 Languages
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 30 日消息，哔哩哔哩 Index LLM 团队今日正式发布 Index-Translate 模型，2B / 9B / 35B-A3B（preview）文本模型权重在 Hugging Face 与 ModelScope 开放。 Index-Translate 是基于 Qwen3.5 构建的多语言翻译模型家族。 文本模型覆盖包括中文、英文在内的 150 种语言 ，支持术语、格式、保留内容等翻译指令，并将共同的多语基础扩展到语音、音节可控翻译和长文档翻译。 Index-Translate：翻译文本、结构化内容与社区表达。 Index-Echo：生成目标语言字幕或配音，配音时参考源语音的说话人声音特征。 Index-Homura：根据指定的目标音节数调整译文。 Index-NativeLong（简称 Index-Nailong）：输入完整文档，利用上下文维持前后联系。 以下为官方精选案例： 翻出社区表达中的意思 原文：狒瘾犯了就去打。在这个游戏社区语境中，“狒瘾”指想玩《最终幻想 XIV》的劲头又上来了。 模型 英文译文 Index-Translate-9B When the FFXIV itch hits, just go play. Index-Translate-2B Go play when my FFXIV addiction kicks in. Hy-MT2…
items.summary_en: Bilibili's Index LLM team released the Index-Translate family, with 2B, 9B and 35B-A3B (preview) text model weights open on Hugging Face and ModelScope. Built on Qwen3.5, the text models cover 150 languages and support terminology, formatting and content-retention instructions, alongside sub-models for dubbing, syllable control and long-document translation.
items.why_zh: 开源多语言翻译模型加上字幕配音与音节控制能力，为社区内容本地化提供了低成本基础设施。
items.why_en: An open multilingual translation family with dubbing and syllable control gives community content localization a low-cost foundation.

items.title_zh: DeepSeek开源昇腾基础组件：国产AI芯片从“能跑”到“好用”
items.title_en: DeepSeek Open-Sources Ascend Base Components, Pushing Domestic AI Chips From 'Runnable' to 'Usable'
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek开源昇腾基础组件：国产AI芯片从“能跑”到“好用” or100.cc
items.summary_en: DeepSeek has open-sourced base components for Huawei's Ascend platform, a move described as pushing domestic AI chips from merely 'runnable' to genuinely 'usable.' The release aims to lower the adaptation cost for developers deploying and optimizing models on domestic compute.
items.why_zh: 补齐软件生态短板，是国产 AI 芯片能否真正被大规模采用的关键环节。
items.why_en: Filling the software-ecosystem gap is critical to whether domestic AI chips can achieve broad, real-world adoption.

items.title_zh: 蚂蚁百灵发布 Ling-3.1-flash 模型：约 560B 总参数、25B 激活参数
items.title_en: Ant Ling Releases Ling-3.1-flash: ~560B Total Parameters, 25B Activated, 1M Context
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 30 日消息，蚂蚁百灵今日发布 Ling-3.1-flash 模型，拥有约 560B 总参数，每个 Token 激活约 25B 参数； 模型上下文窗口上限为 1M ，可容纳更长的文档、代码和任务历史。 官方表示，在研发过程中，围绕通用智能体、搜索、日常办公和软件研发等任务持续优化，并在医疗、金融和材料科学研究等场景持续提升模型能力。 此外， Ling-3.1-flash 将开放为期两周的免费体验 ；考虑到综合服务成本，免费体验期间模型服务长度为 256K。 免费体验期结束并转为付费服务后，计划开放 1M 上下文。届时， 团队也计划同步开源 ，并继续更新模型性能。 IT之家附这款模型在多个任务评测中得分如下：
items.summary_en: Ant's Ling team released Ling-3.1-flash, a model with roughly 560B total parameters and about 25B activated per token, supporting up to a 1M-token context window. It offers a two-week free trial at 256K context, with a planned paid 1M-context release, open-sourcing and continued performance updates.
items.why_zh: 稀疏大模型以高总参数、低激活成本换取大上下文与智能体能力，代表国产模型在效率路线上的竞争。
items.why_en: A sparse model pairing high total parameters with low activation cost reflects domestic competition on efficiency and long-context agent capability.

items.title_zh: Kimi K3接入OpenAI Codex企业通道 中国开源模型首次进入其采购体系
items.title_en: Kimi K3 Gains Access to OpenAI Codex Enterprise Channel, a First for a Chinese Open-Source Model
items.summary_zh: Kimi K3接入OpenAI Codex企业通道 中国开源模型首次进入其采购体系 观点网
items.summary_en: Chinese media outlet Guandian reports that Moonshot's Kimi K3 model has been connected to OpenAI's Codex enterprise channel, reportedly the first Chinese open-source model to enter that procurement system. Details on the scope, pricing and deployment of the integration have not been disclosed.
items.why_zh: 若属实，这是中国开源模型首次被纳入 OpenAI 企业级产品的采购体系，具有标志性意义。
items.why_en: If confirmed, it marks the first time a Chinese open-source model has been admitted into OpenAI's enterprise procurement system.

items.title_zh: DeepSeek 开源昇腾平台基础设施组件，覆盖 TileLang、计算库与分布式通信库
items.title_en: DeepSeek Open-Sources Ascend Infrastructure Components Spanning TileLang, Compute and Distributed Communication Libraries
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek 开源昇腾平台基础设施组件，覆盖 TileLang、计算库与分布式通信库 InfoQ-CN
items.summary_en: DeepSeek has open-sourced a set of infrastructure components for Huawei's Ascend platform, covering TileLang as well as compute and distributed communication libraries. The release aims to strengthen the low-level software stack of the domestic AI chip ecosystem and lower the barrier to training and inference on Ascend hardware.
items.why_zh: 补齐昇腾软件栈有助于降低国产算力的使用门槛，推动 AI 训练与推理摆脱对单一生态的依赖。
items.why_en: Filling gaps in the Ascend software stack lowers the barrier to domestic compute and reduces reliance on a single hardware ecosystem.

items.title_zh: DeepSeek Harness桌面端预览版v0.2正式发布
items.title_en: DeepSeek Harness Desktop Preview v0.2 Released
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek Harness桌面端预览版v0.2正式发布 三易生活
items.summary_en: DeepSeek has released version 0.2 of its Harness desktop client as a preview build, according to Sanyi Life. The report did not detail the specific features, supported platforms or distribution channels of the release.
items.why_zh: 桌面端产品的迭代反映出 DeepSeek 正从模型层向开发者与终端工具层延伸。
items.why_en: Continued desktop client updates show DeepSeek extending from models toward developer and end-user tooling.

items.title_zh: DeepSeek 开源算子工具大礼包，联手华为昇腾，手撕 CUDA 绑定！
items.title_en: DeepSeek Open-Sources Operator Toolset in Push With Huawei Ascend to Break CUDA Lock-In
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek 开源算子工具大礼包，联手华为昇腾，手撕 CUDA 绑定！ 雷峰网
items.summary_en: Leiphone reports that DeepSeek has open-sourced a set of operator tools and is working with Huawei's Ascend to loosen CUDA's grip on AI compute. The move signals closer collaboration between domestic model and chip makers on operators and software stacks, though no component list or performance figures were given.
items.why_zh: 算子层是摆脱 CUDA 依赖的关键环节，模型与芯片厂商联手有望加速国产算力生态成熟。
items.why_en: Operators are the key battleground for escaping CUDA lock-in, and model-chip collaboration could speed up the domestic compute ecosystem.

items.title_zh: 868 元：70 迈发布双主摄行车记录仪 E800，前后双 4K
items.title_en: 70mai Launches E800 Dash Cam With Dual 4K Cameras at 868 Yuan
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 30 日消息，70 迈今天宣布推出双主摄行车记录仪 E800，新品拥有前后 4K 主摄，具备超级电容， 定价 868 元 ，现已在京东开售。 据介绍，这款行车记录仪采用前后双 4K 摄像头，光圈为 F1.55，视角 140 度，缩小视野盲区。搭载 HDR 动态调校，可在白天和黑夜输出清晰影像。 同时，该行车记录仪配备 3.18 英寸显示屏，支持本机直接回看。具备 App 手机互联功能，支持 Wi-Fi 6，最高下载速度可达 25MB/s，还带有停车场找车、智能电压检测、车辆行驶轨迹等功能。 此外，该行车记录仪配备超级电容，发生碰撞时可单独锁定 100 秒视频。支持全天候停车监控，记录车辆周围变化。 IT之家附该行车记录仪详细参数如下： 目前该产品已在京东开售，定价 868 元。 京东 70 迈 70MAI 行车记录仪 E800 868 元 直达链接
items.summary_en: 70mai has launched the E800 dash cam, featuring front and rear 4K cameras with F1.55 apertures and a 140-degree field of view plus HDR tuning. It offers a 3.18-inch display, Wi-Fi 6 connectivity up to 25MB/s, a supercapacitor that locks 100 seconds of footage on impact, and 24/7 parking monitoring, priced at 868 yuan on JD.com.
items.why_zh: 前后双 4K 与超级电容的配置把高端行车记录仪的价格进一步下探到千元以内。
items.why_en: Dual 4K cameras plus a supercapacitor bring high-end dash cam specs under the 1,000-yuan mark.

items.why_zh: 国内大模型厂商持续向昇腾生态贡献基础组件，有助于国产软硬件协同走向成熟。
items.why_en: Ongoing contributions to the Ascend ecosystem help mature domestic hardware-software co-development.

items.title_zh: 快手高管调整：创始人程一笑兼任社科线负责人，于越转任可灵 CEO
items.title_en: Kuaishou Shuffles Executives: Cheng Yixiao Takes Over Community Science Line, Yu Yue Becomes Kling CEO
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 30 日消息，据申妈的朋友圈，快手发布公告，宣布高管分工调整：快手创始人兼首席执行官 程一笑 将兼任社区科学线负责人；原社区科学线负责人 于越 转任可灵 AI 公司董事兼首席执行官，未来将专注于可灵 AI 的经营管理。 程一笑在随后发布的全员信中表达了对于越的感谢，并表示 可灵始终是快手 AI 战略的核心布局 ，未来仍将与快手各业务协同共生、价值共赢。 据IT之家此前报道，快手可灵 AI 宣布， Kling 4.0 将于 10 月正式上线 。其中，Kling 4.0 Flash 于 9 月 28 日率先开放小范围体验。 Kling 4.0 支持 4K、1080p 的 10-bit HDR 格式输出；单次输入最多 10 张图片、5 段视频及 7 个主体，在同一生成任务组合使用；支持单次生成视频最长可达 30 秒，支持长镜头与连续叙事。 此外，快手今日还宣布成立跨事业部虚拟组织「 企业 AI 生产力 」，负责基础办公系统基座的稳定运行，统筹通用 Agent、企业上下文体系和企业信息系统的统一建设。 相比其他互联网企业整合办公套件和通用 Agent 的做法，快手进一步将内部信息系统纳入此次统一建设范围内。
items.summary_en: Kuaishou announced an executive reshuffle: founder and CEO Cheng Yixiao will concurrently lead the community science line, while Yu Yue moves to serve as director and CEO of Kling AI. Kuaishou also said Kling 4.0 will launch in October with 4K/1080p 10-bit HDR output and up to 30-second videos, and set up a cross-division "Enterprise AI Productivity" unit for agents and internal systems.
items.why_zh: 让创始人直管科学线、由专职 CEO 独立经营可灵，显示快手把 AI 与视频生成提升为核心战略级业务。
items.why_en: Putting the founder over the science line and giving Kling a dedicated CEO signals that AI and video generation are now core strategic priorities for Kuaishou.

items.summary_en: Reports indicate that Chinese open-source models such as Kimi K3 have been integrated into OpenAI's enterprise services, marking a new step in OpenAI's embrace of third-party open models on the business side. Details on access methods, coverage and pricing remain limited.
items.why_zh: 若属实，这意味着中国开源模型首次被纳入 OpenAI 的企业服务体系，改变了其此前相对封闭的模型供应格局。
items.why_en: If confirmed, this marks one of the first times Chinese open-source models enter OpenAI's enterprise lineup, shifting its previously closed model supply.

items.title_zh: 中国大模型首次进入 OpenAI 企业付费结算体系，Kimi K3 接入 Codex 企业通道
items.title_en: Chinese Model Kimi K3 Enters OpenAI's Enterprise Billing System via Codex
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 30 日消息，美国 AI 基础设施公司 Baseten 今天宣布与 OpenAI 达成合作，成为 OpenAI B2B 市场首批开源模型推理服务提供商之一。企业用户可通过 Codex 使用 Kimi K3 和 GLM 5.3 等开源模型，意味着中国开源模型首次进入 OpenAI 企业采购体系。 IT之家了解到，Kimi K3 是月之暗面开发的大模型。官方宣称其是首个参数规模达 2.8 万亿的开源模型。该模型原生支持视觉能力， 拥有 100 万 Token 的上下文窗口 ，非常适合执行长时间编程、多文档分析等工作。 如今，OpenAI 企业用户可通过 Codex 或 Responses API 调用 Kimi K3 等开源模型，以相同的预算获得更多 AI 能力。Baseten 承诺其提供的所有模型均运行在美国服务器，针对所有提示词实行零数据保留（ZDR）。
items.summary_en: Baseten said it has partnered with OpenAI to become one of the first open-model inference providers on OpenAI's B2B marketplace, letting enterprise users call Chinese models like Moonshot's Kimi K3 and GLM 5.3 through Codex or the Responses API. Kimi K3 is claimed to be the first open-source model with 2.8 trillion parameters, native vision and a 1M-token context window; Baseten promises US-based servers and zero data retention.
items.why_zh: 这是中国开源模型首次被纳入 OpenAI 的企业采购与结算渠道，意味着中美模型生态在企业级市场上出现新的交叉。
items.why_en: It is the first time Chinese open-source models are included in OpenAI's enterprise procurement and billing channel, creating a new intersection between US and Chinese model ecosystems.
